tasks.name: check-status
tasks.title: Check Status
tasks.desc:
Confirms the workflow is running correctly before anything else executes.
Running on: [glob computer-name], cycleNo: [glob cycle], eventNo: [glob event]

tasks.title: Remedial Action
tasks.name: remedial-action
tasks.desc: Demonstrates taking corrective action when a previous task fails - such as correcting a bad database entry. Stays hidden until Check Status reports FAIL or TRAP.

tasks.title: Publish Results
tasks.name: publish-results
tasks.desc: Publishes results downstream. Only runs once Check Status has succeeded -- proceeding without that confirmation risks publishing from a bad state.
